policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Fifteen matches in, the LSC table is still empty, and conference play is 24 days away.

Midwestern State has scored eleven goals and conceded one; Sul Ross State has conceded eight and scored none. Three matches are marked final with no score published, and three more sit past their date with no result recorded.
No conference match has been played, so all eleven programmes sit at 0–0–0 and the table carries early form from non-conference results only.
3–1–0 points · conference play opens September 23, 24 days after this collection · a pre-conference table is a valid state.
Midwestern State has scored eleven goals in non-conference play, more than any two other programmes have scored together.
All three matches marked final without a published score are Lubbock Christian's — August 15, August 19 and August 22 — and three further matches are past their date with no result recorded.
Against opponents from outside the conference the eleven programmes have won seven, drawn one and lost five, scoring 26 goals and conceding 24.
